dishes.n: Peameal back bacon on a bun
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the maple mustard up to 3 days ahead; crumb and fry the bacon just before serving

steps.text: Cut the bacon into thick slices and press both sides into the cornmeal.
Fry in oil over medium heat, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Fry the onions in the same pan.
Mix the mustard with the maple syrup. Split and toast the buns, spread with maple mustard and fill with bacon and onions.

veg.n: Peameal-style smoked tofu on a bun
veg.make_ahead: Brush the tofu with the soy and maple up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and mix the maple mustard up to 3 days ahead; crumb and fry on the night

steps.text: Cut the tofu into thick slices, brush with the soy sauce and a tablespoon of the maple syrup, then press both sides into the cornmeal.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Fry the onions in the same pan.
Mix the mustard with the rest of the maple syrup. Split and toast the buns, spread with maple mustard and fill with the tofu and onions.

dishes.make_ahead: Pipe the rings onto baking paper up to 4 hours ahead and keep chilled; fry and glaze just before serving

steps.text: Bring water, butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Beat in the flour until it forms a ball, then cool.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
Pipe rings with a star nozzle onto squares of baking paper.
Lower into oil at 180C paper side up, peel off the paper and fry, turning once, until golden. Drain.
Whisk the icing sugar, honey and water and dip the warm crullers.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the gravy up to 2 days ahead and reheat until very hot; bake the chips and assemble on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until nutty.
Whisk in the stock, Worcestershire and pepper and simmer until glossy.
Tear the cheese into pieces. Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the cheese over and pour the very hot gravy on top.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom gravy up to 2 days ahead and reheat until very hot; bake the chips and assemble on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter and cook the mushrooms until browned, then stir in the flour and cook until nutty.
Whisk in the stock, soy sauce and pepper and simmer until glossy.
Tear the cheese into pieces. Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the cheese over and pour the very hot gravy on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 2 days ahead, airtight; warm for 5 minutes at 150C if you like them soft

steps.text: Cut rounds from the pastry and press into a greased muffin tin.
Whisk the sugar, maple syrup, butter, egg, vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Put raisins and pecans into each case and pour the filling two-thirds of the way up.
Bake at 190C until the filling bubbles and is just set.
Cool in the tin.

dishes.make_ahead: Stir the maple lemon mix up to 2 days ahead and chill; chill the glasses and lager, then pour to order

steps.text: Stir the maple syrup with the juice of two lemons in a jug. Chill the beer glasses.
Pour a spoonful of the maple lemon mix into each glass and half fill with cold lager.
Top with lemonade, pouring slowly down the side to keep the head. Add a lemon wedge.

af.make_ahead: Stir the maple lemon mix up to 2 days ahead and chill; chill the glasses and alcohol-free lager, then pour to order

steps.text: Stir the maple syrup with the juice of two lemons in a jug. Chill the beer glasses.
Pour a spoonful of the maple lemon mix into each glass and half fill with cold alcohol-free lager.
Top with lemonade, pouring slowly down the side to keep the head. Add a lemon wedge.
